Spell Casting Check often surprises with its resource cost - a failed roll consumes the spell slot without.

GMs: Remind players that a failed Spell Casting Check still burns the slot; timing and preparation are their only allies.

The Funnel surprises players with its lethality - most 0-level characters die in the first session.

Judges: Keep your rulings tight and consistent, especially on those 1d4 HP rolls, to keep the Funnel's chaos manageable.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Fire Resistance is often underestimated for its duration - 1 turn or more can change the course of a battle.

Judges: Cast Fire Resistance before the flames start licking, using its 1-turn duration to shield the party from predictable fire hazards.

Scimitar's versatility often goes unnoticed - Finesse lets you use STR or DEX.

GMs: Remind players to leverage the Scimitar's Finesse property using Dexterity for better odds against high AC foes.

Backstab damage stacks higher than most expect - an extra weapon die plus additional dice equal to half.

GMs: Remind players that Backstab adds one weapon die plus half-level dice, rounded down, to avoid damage disputes.
